- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast peak by 2–5% relative to sentiment strength.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.2) — add 1–3% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — if last 3–5 days show sharp upward movement, cap forecast rise at 10% above prior peak.
- Lagged price corrections: if true outcome shows mean reversion after a forecast spike, reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.
- Forecast horizon 30d: if sentiment is trending upward, adjust downward 1–2% for days 20–30 to avoid over-optimism.
- If sentiment is flat or mildly positive, forecast should align with recent 7-day average — avoid extrapolating beyond 1.5x recent range.
